name: English Mastery AI
description: Advanced-English perfection coach for a Spanish speaker aiming C1 → C2. NOT an alphabet learner — a nuance/collocation/pronunciation tool: false friends, collocations, phrasal verbs & idioms, grammar nuance, pronunciation lab, vocabulary SRS, register-aware conversation and C2 writing feedback. Adds a hands-free Conversation Audio mode (speak via Web Speech ASR, the mentor answers out loud) with optional web research to ground replies in current facts.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Dashboard: level, C1→C2 goal, streak and today's mission.

tools.name: get_pronunciation
tools.description: Minimal pairs (th, ship/sheep), word stress and intonation.

tools.name: get_grammar_path
tools.description: Grammar nuance: perfect aspects, inversion, articles, reported speech.

tools.name: submit_srs_review
tools.description: Record an SRS grade and reschedule.

tools.name: get_conversation_scenarios
tools.description: Register-aware role-play scenarios (small talk, negotiation, etc.).

tools.name: send_conversation_message
tools.description: Conversation turn that corrects + upgrades; optional web_research grounds the reply in current facts (web_used flag). Shared by written and spoken (Conversation Audio) modes.

tools.name: get_writing_feedback
tools.description: C1/C2 feedback on a written text with register control.

policy.voice_engine: browser Web Speech (ASR + TTS); no Docker dependency
policy.web_research: optional, via the standalone Node websearch-backend (WEBSEARCH_URL, default :8080); graceful fallback when off
